author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Self-Organizing Systems - Enhanced Team Formation with Communication
abstract: This submission advances research into 'Self-Organizing Multi-Agent Systems' with an 'Enhanced Team Formation Game.' It introduces a two-phase communication-decision process: agents first broadcast their intended team choice for the current round. Then, they make their final team selection, incorporating observed signals from others and a stronger balancing incentive. Agents learn the effectiveness of their signals and refine their interpretation of others' signals. This experiment aims to determine if explicit communication facilitates self-organization into stable and balanced teams, optimizing for collective reward in a dynamic environment.
